items.rationale: Covered under 2.6.2/2.6.3(a): swerve in a conveyance, screen breakage. Purchase price about EUR 1,400; both repairs together stay below new price, so repair is economic (7.1.10). Display takes most of the cost, estimated around EUR 800.

Covered under 2.6.3(b): housing deformation at a corner from the same event, whether or not operation is impaired. Lower shell plus labour estimated at about EUR 380; combined with line 1 still below new price.
Excluded by 7.1.11 and 2.6.5(b): treating a pre-existing surface condition is not a repair cost, even on the same invoice.
Covered under 5.2.3 as examination cost after an insured event under 2.6, capped at EUR 250 incl. VAT. Ordinary diagnostic fee is about EUR 70, well under the cap.
